**Finding submitted: deviation (WARRANTY).**

- **What exists:** Article 15 gives only Effective Date representations — mutual corporate/authority reps (15.1), Array IP ownership, non-conflict, no-litigation and past-Development-compliance reps (15.2, p0691–p0703) — and a mutual disclaimer of implied warranties at 15.4 (p0711).
- **What's absent:** No forward-looking conformance or performance warranty for the Materials Array supplies under Article 9, and no repair/replace/refund remedy. Conformance is deferred to a clinical supply agreement and a future Supply/Quality Agreement (p0501, p0510) that merely "shall contain ... product specifications" and are unexecuted.
- **Why deviation, not compliant:** This sits below the fallback (90-day conformance warranty with real remedy). Notably it is not walk-away territory — the disclaimer is mutual and opens "Except as otherwise expressly set forth in this Agreement," so it does not swallow express warranties and needs no carve-out edit.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** New Section 15.4 warranting that Materials conform in all material respects to applicable specifications, are Manufactured under GMP and applicable Law, and are free of liens, with rejection within 90 days of delivery (or 90 days from discovery for latent defects) and replacement or refund at Array's option — fallback-level language matching precedent seed-warranty, with an offer to align mechanics to the Quality Agreements.
